# AM Enhancer repository artwork

Both AM Enhancer repositories use the exact same user-selected red musical-note artwork, supplied in `assets/am-enhancer-icon.png` and `.github/branding/social-preview.png`.

The README logo is live after Git push. GitHub repository **social preview** is a separate repository setting and **does not activate just by committing** this PNG. Maintainers can upload `social-preview.png` under repository **Settings → General → Social preview → Upload an image**. GitHub does not provide a documented REST repository social-preview upload API. The GitHub account/profile avatar is separate and is intentionally not modified.

This public repository contains binary-distribution metadata and branding images only; never upload the private Android application source or signing keys here.
